titleStmt.title: The Woman Who Frightened Her Baby

body.p: A woman gave birth to a child while she was out berrying. She laid it on some grass and went on berrying. Soon she came back and crept toward the child, and then sprang forward and cried "Ah!" to frighten it. Then she went away; but soon she came back, and did the same thing again. She repeated this performance four times; and the fourth time, the child changed into a little bird and flew away.
